option_relations.rationale: Congenital Myopathy is a broad category of muscle disorders, while the provided leaf is a specific neuromuscular junction disorder. There is no direct relation between the two.
Autosomal dominant centronuclear (myotubular) myopathy is a specific type of congenital myopathy, which is distinct from congenital myasthenic syndrome.
SCN4A-associated congenital myopathy is a specific genetic myopathy, which is distinct from congenital myasthenic syndrome.

Congenital Muscular Dystrophy is a group of genetic muscle disorders characterized by muscle weakness and wasting, which is distinct from congenital myasthenic syndrome, a disorder of the neuromuscular junction.
